The video begins in 1978 Los Angeles, California, with a person (S1) with a large afro hairstyle, wearing a red patterned shirt and a white scarf, looking out a large window at a blurred cityscape. S1 turns around, smiling, and says, "That's what people want. Pure escapism, Quincy." I need the freedom to write the melodies and lyrics in my head."
